habitos.feito_faltou_nao_valia_ou: done · □ missed · · didn't count (or no mark, for "x a week") ·

calendario.nenhum_lembrete_crie_um_aqui: no reminders — create one here, from "remind me" on a note, bill, goal, habit or event, or with

calendario.nenhum_evento_para_o_filtro: no events for the selected filter.

calendario_tips.aqui_ficam_todos_os_seus: all your commitments for the month live here: bills, debts, subscriptions, installments, goals, actions, events and reminders, all in one place.
calendario_tips.navegue_entre_os_meses_p: move between months here, or use "today" to jump straight back to the current month.

calendario_tips.pra_cadastrar_um_evento_: to add a manual event (one that doesn't come from any other module), use this button.
calendario_evento.remover_este_evento_e_: remove this event and ALL its repetitions? this doesn't affect the other kinds of event in the calendar (bills, debts, goals...).
calendario_alertas.nada_vencendo_nos_pro: nothing due in the next few days.
lembrete.ex_ligar_pro_banco_tomar: e.g. call the bank, take the medicine

lembrete.preencha_o_dia_e_a: fill in the day and the time.
lembrete.escolha_pelo_menos_um_dia: pick at least one day of the week.
lembrete.avisa_dentro_do_kami_e: alerts inside kami and, if turned on in settings › notifications, through the system too. only with kami open (or in the tray).

conquista.ex_ingles_tem_que_aparecer: e.g. english — it has to appear in the action's description
conquista.de_um_nome_e_diga: give it a name and say how many actions (1 or more).
lembretes_agendador.enquanto_o_kami_esta: while kami was closed — they're in the bell
metas.excluir_confirma: Delete the goal "{meta}"? Its contribution history will also be deleted (real transactions already logged in Finances stay there).
metas_tips.contribuir: every time you really make progress on this goal, log it here — that's what moves the progress bar. contributing earns xp once a day per goal; the completion bonus always comes.
habitos.apagar_confirma: Delete the habit "{nome}"? Its history goes away. To keep the history, archive it instead.
habitos.apagar_confirma_xp: Delete the habit "{nome}"? Its history goes away and the {xp} xp from its {n} check-ins are taken back. To keep the history, archive it instead.
